verdict.rationale: Termius documents a built-in Local terminal alongside its SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial and SFTP connections, which is the capability for running local shell commands such as ls, grep and tar inside the app. The evidence is a single short doc mention with no further detail. missing for 10: dedicated local-terminal documentation (shell selection, configuration), explicit statement of which platforms get the local shell (desktop vs. iOS/Android), independent or hands-on corroboration of local command use.
